_note: Image-generation backends for PosterLoom. Each backend declares its own limits because they change the workflow: a prompt-length cap forces a rebuilt (not truncated) prompt, and an unsupported aspect ratio forces an explicit substitution.

minimax.name: MiniMax image-01
notes: Only one reference image per request.
Rejects prompts at or above 1500 characters — PosterLoom's full prompt is 4000-8000, so use compact_prompt.build_compact().
Does NOT support 3:5. The two zine styles are designed for 3:5; the ratio is mapped to the nearest supported value and the substitution is reported.

Text-to-image applies the style faithfully. Image-to-image often keeps the photographic rendering and can introduce a different person, so the reference is best used for identity anchoring on portrait work.
